test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Up the ante
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"up the ante"** means to increase the level of demands, risks, or stakes in a situation. (मांगों को बढ़ाना)

 
 
• **Example:** The company decided to **up the ante **by offering a higher salary to attract top talent.
 
 
 
• **"Increase demands"** refers to making higher demands or requirements in a given situation. (मांगों को बढ़ाना)
 
 
• **Example:** During the negotiation, the union decided to** increase demands** for better working conditions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cost cutting **(लागत में कटौती): The action of reducing expenses or expenditures.

 
 
• **Example:** The company implemented cost-cutting measures to improve its profit margins.
 
 
 
• **Mediocre **(साधारण): Of only average quality; not very good.
 
 
• **Example:** His performance was mediocre, neither outstanding nor terrible.
 
 
 
• **Expensive **(महंगा): Costing a lot of money.
 
 
• **Example:** The new smartphone model is very expensive, making it unaffordable for many people.
 
 

308:Tafc,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
